settings.label: Business name
settings.help: As your customers know it. Example: Ranime Jemal Agency

settings.label: Google Calendar to use
settings.help: Leave "primary" to use your main calendar. For another calendar: Google Calendar, Settings, the calendar, Integrate calendar, Calendar ID.

settings.label: Open days
settings.help: Day numbers separated by commas: 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday … 7 = Sunday. Example: 1,2,3,4,5 for Monday to Friday.

settings.label: Your team's email
settings.help: Where alerts and copies are sent. Example: hello@yourbusiness.com

settings.label: Google Sheet link
settings.help: Create an empty Google Sheet, add the tabs from the guide, then copy the link from your browser's address bar and paste it here.

settings.label: Sender name on emails
settings.help: The name people see in their inbox. Example: Sarah from Maison Lina
